GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 523 (3 Mar 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 786)
APO 500
3 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Request for Allotment of Shipping to Yangtze River Area.
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. No.872 (5.2), 23 February 1946, subject as above.
2. Evacuation of the Japanese nationals in the upper reacher of the Yangtze River above Anking to Shanghai is the responsibility of the Chinese National Government.
3. The request of the Imperial Japanese Government in this matter therefore has been referred to the Commanding General, United States Forces China Theater.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
